text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand delivered a thrilling 
performance in the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Voices of anticipation for her future 
could be heard from all across the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, having never faced great 
expectations before, that sudden pressure 
ended up having the opposite effect on 
Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to continue being someone who can 
live up to expectations— even though the 
race has just ended, she tries to resume 
her grueling training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until she could calm her cornered and 
overwhelmed feelings, it was decided she 
should take a break and rest for a while.
